card.title: How To Fix iPhone 16 Pro Face ID and All Cameras Not Working

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 16 Pro Face ID and All Cameras Not Working

claims.statement: On iPhone 16 Pro / Pro Max, a shorted front camera (TrueDepth) module can take down every camera and Face ID because of a shared rail/I2C; a known-good module makes the cameras initialise.
iPhone 16 series can pair a used replacement front camera through Settings > General > About > Parts & Service History > Restart & Finish Repair.

procedure: Confirm all lenses black and Face ID unavailable.
Test with a known-good front camera.
Fit replacement module and pair it via Parts & Service History.
Test all lenses, flashlight, Face ID enrolment.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
